simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to קֶצֶו (H7099) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: קֶצֶו (qetsev) means a limit First listed occurrence: Isa 26 15.

definitions.full: H7099. qatsu [ קָ֫צוּ ] noun [masculine] end, boundary ; (on form Kö ii. 1, 61 ); — only plural construct קַצְוֵיאֶֿרֶץ ends of the earth Psa 48:11 ; 65:6 ; boundaries of the land Isa 26:15 .
definitions.rootNote: and (feminine) קִצְוָה ; from 7096 ; (used like 7097 , but with less variety)
